nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. Use <Picture 2> and <Picture 1> as reference frames and <Audio 1> exactly as it is.
CUT 1: top-down view of the little boy superhero on the rooftop — red cape fluttering in the wind, hands planted on his hips, freckles and a cocky grin as he looks straight up into the camera. The camera slowly descends toward him as he delivers his line — as he speaks, comic-book graphic overlay text word by word in sync with his voice: "GET READY TO" - "MEET" — "YOUR" — "MAKER" — huge jagged comic lettering, white with heavy black outlines and red drop shadows, tilted at scrappy angles, until the three words hang stacked in the air above him between his face and the lens.
TRANSITION: a violent WHIP PAN off the rooftop that SMEARS the floating words away with it, motion-streaked —
CUT 2: low hero angle on the colossal black mech-kaiju towering over the skyline as it rears back and unleashes a GIANT terrifying ROAR — jaws wide with fangs, red eyes and chest-core flaring blinding bright, blue lightning arcing off its head, the roar's shockwave rippling dust and rattling windows down the buildings, comic-style speed-lines and ink splatter bursting from the impact of the sound. It leans INTO the camera as the roar peaks. Hold on the roar.

subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> - one young woman in a close-up portrait, fair skin, brown hair loosely tied back with loose wisps around her face, light blue-gray eyes, subtle freckles, glossy pink lips, soft natural eyebrows, and a white ruffled garment; preserve her facial proportions, visible traits, expression range, wardrobe, and single-subject count without identifying her or inferring sensitive attributes.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a 15.00-second vertical 4:5 cinematic reference-to-video portrait. Preserve <Picture 1> as the sole visible subject and maintain her recognizable facial features, brown hair, light eyes, freckles, glossy pink lips, white ruffled garment, and gentle close-up composition. Develop the neutral portrait into a physically coherent surreal moonlit garden: restrained wind, luminous petals, reflective dew, and a subtle sense of wonder, with no invented identity, factual claim, logo, or readable text.

retention_analysis:
Use an elegant surreal editorial-film style with realistic skin texture, physically plausible motion, delicate practical lighting, and a controlled transition from studio portrait to moonlit garden. Keep the woman’s face dominant in the 4:5 frame, with no additional people, duplicate features, identity changes, or text.
[Shot 1] Begin on the source-like close-up composition: the woman occupies nearly the full vertical frame, facing slightly toward camera while her eyes glance off to the side, with a faint closed-mouth smile. The neutral gray background and soft frontal illumination remain stable. A barely perceptible breeze lifts two loose strands of brown hair; the strands settle naturally against her cheek. The camera makes a slow, smooth push-in of only a few centimeters at low speed, preserving facial proportions and sharp focus on both eyes. Quiet room tone and the faint rustle of fabric accompany the movement.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, cut to the same portrait angle and subject position as the gray background gradually reveals a shallow-focus garden texture behind her: dark foliage, tiny dew points, and distant cool lights. The change is an environmental development, not a replacement of the subject. She slowly shifts her gaze from the side toward the lens, completing the movement by 00:05.000; her expression remains calm and gently curious. A few translucent petals drift upward from the lower edge, moving with the same breeze and never crossing or obscuring her eyes. The camera performs a restrained lateral arc to the right, less than ten degrees, at slow speed.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, moonlike light blooms softly behind her hair, creating a thin rim light while warm reflected light remains on her cheeks and lips. She blinks once naturally, then slightly tilts her chin upward, completing the small pose adjustment by 00:09.000. More luminous petals circle in a readable shallow spiral around the frame edges; each petal has visible motion blur and settles into a gentle downward drift. Her white ruffled garment stays unchanged and visible at the lower corners. The camera eases backward a few centimeters, maintaining the intimate portrait scale.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the garden lights brighten subtly as dew-like points gather on nearby out-of-focus leaves. The woman holds her gaze toward camera with the same soft closed-mouth smile. One petal passes near her shoulder and comes to rest out of focus in the foreground; no object touches her face. The breeze diminishes, allowing the loose hair strands and garment ruffles to settle. The camera completes a slow stabilization into a nearly still frame by 00:13.500.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.800, hold the finished moonlit portrait for the remaining 1.200 seconds. Keep her face, eyes, freckles, lips, hair, garment, and single-subject count fully consistent. The background remains softly luminous and legible as a garden without introducing signs, labels, subtitles, banners, logos, or invented lettering. End on a settled natural blink-free gaze and quiet breath, with no abrupt transformation or state reversal.
<Picture 1> - partially_preserved - the single woman, facial structure, visible complexion details, brown hair, light blue-gray eyes, freckles, glossy pink lips, white ruffled garment, and close-up portrait framing remain consistent.

detailed_description:
r34l1sm, The target video uses a coherent cinematic style derived from the supplied references, with physically plausible motion, readable composition, and continuity of visible identity, wardrobe, props, lighting, and setting. Camera movement is deliberate and the reference influence remains clear across the full duration.
[Shot 1] Begin from the visible composition established by <Picture 1> and develop the requested action with a controlled camera move while preserving visible continuity.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous intimate natural ambience: faint night air, distant soft insects, and subtle leaves moving in the breeze. Synchronize each visible hair lift, petal pass, fabric movement, blink, and settling motion with delicate rustles and light air movement. Include only non-verbal human sounds, such as a quiet natural breath; no dialogue or voiceover.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained audience-only score uses glassy celesta notes, soft felt piano, sparse harp harmonics, and a low warm string pad at approximately sixty beats per minute. Begin with isolated notes, add a gentle rising three-note figure as the garden appears, then taper to sustained quiet tones during the final hold.
